verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official Model Context Protocol server that lets users drive Adyen through natural language from their chosen LLM client, and a probe confirms the dedicated MCP server docs page exists. That delivers the core of the story, but the pack shows only a one-line description of it. Missing for 10: documented tool/capability list (including whether it covers Agentic Commerce flows), setup/auth details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
